title: Golden-vector manifest (ADR 0013 5.2)
description: Structurally compared golden vectors for the MQTT field contract. Payloads are embedded as JSON objects because the contract is field-normative (names/presence/types/null-omission binding; member order and whitespace are not): an embedded object cannot pin a byte form. One manifest file per authority ('field' = lifted from the Go producer paths, 'ems' = lifted from the C# MqttJson serializer); each side regenerates only its own file.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Naming follows the replay-manifest.v1 precedent.

contract.description: Which field contract the vectors pin. Modbus vectors (ADR 0013 5.4) will extend this enum.

authority.description: Producer authority per ADR 0013 3: 'field' covers telemetry/status/fault/command_ack (Go simulator is the de-facto producer), 'ems' covers command (C# EMS produces).

name.description: Unique case name within the manifest.

topic_name.description: Logical topic name as declared in the mqtt-mapping profile.

direction.description: Direction from the .NET-EMS adapter's perspective, same vocabulary as mqtt-mapping.json.

topic.description: Resolved broker topic with the fixed test asset id substituted (e.g. battery/asset-1/telemetry).

retained.description: Retained flag from the mqtt-mapping profile.

payload.description: The normative payload as a JSON object (field-normative; never a byte-encoded string).

suppressed.description: The producer emits NO message for this input (e.g. fault topic with fault_status ok/empty). Mutually exclusive with payload.
